# OnPoint Pros

> Family-owned home-services company headquartered in Allen, TX, serving Allen, Frisco, Plano, McKinney, Prosper, Wylie, Murphy, Sachse, Rowlett, Garland and the wider North Dallas / DFW area. Core services: drywall & sheetrock repair, flooring installation, interior & cabinet painting, and bathroom remodeling (flagship). Fully insured and bonded. Rated 5.0 across 41 Google reviews. Phone: (469) 238-1719.

## Services (pillars)
- [Home Refresh & Interior Remodeling](https://onpointprostx.com/services/home-refresh.html): whole-room makeovers — drywall repair, interior painting, flooring, trim and finish carpentry as one project, one crew. Typical DFW cost: $5k–$20k per refresh, 1–4 weeks. Real before/after photos: https://onpointprostx.com/blog/case-room-refresh-north-dfw.html
- [Drywall & Sheetrock Repair](https://onpointprostx.com/services/drywall-repair.html): hole patches, knockdown/orange-peel texture matching, popcorn ceiling removal, water-damage & ceiling repair. Typical DFW cost: $150–$400 a patch, $400–$1,200 larger/ceiling, ~$1–$2/sq ft popcorn removal.
- [Flooring Installation](https://onpointprostx.com/services/flooring.html): luxury vinyl plank (LVP), hardwood, tile, laminate, carpet, subfloor leveling. Typical DFW cost installed: LVP $3–$7/sq ft, hardwood $6–$12, tile $5–$10.
- [Bathroom Remodeling](https://onpointprostx.com/services/bathroom-remodel.html): walk-in showers, tub-to-shower conversions, full remodels with Schluter waterproofing. Typical DFW cost: $8k–$15k guest bath, $18k–$45k full master, 2–4 weeks.
- [Painting](https://onpointprostx.com/services/painting.html) and [Handyman](https://onpointprostx.com/services/handyman-services.html).
